summary: L-4 cab in the Kootenai National Forest, built 1930 and destroyed 1959. A hiking trail reaches the summit, where a trail guide reports lookout remnants.

facts.status_note: Destroyed in 1959. A trail guide reports only remnants on the summit.

visit.trail_note: Trail No. 324: eight-mile round trip, about 2,800 feet of gain, rated hard. Driving directions to the trailhead start at MT-56.

events.note: firelookout.com lists an L-4 cab under 1930

evidence.quote: will eventually bring you to the summit
From MT-56, turn west onto Troy Mine Road

evidence.supports: summit shows remnants of a lookout tower
evidence.quote: The peaks summit shows remnants of a forgotten lookout tower

notes_for_editor: The sources do not clearly agree on the structure: firelookout.com says L-4 cab, the FFLA list says ground lookout, and the trail guide says lookout tower remnants. The guide's remnants claim is undated and is the only evidence about the site today. The guide sits under a Scotchman Peaks Wilderness heading but places the peak in Montana's Cabinets; not reconciled. Access is not stated, so no access key is written. A search listing (AllTrails) labelled a Spar Peak trail CLOSED and placed it in Idaho; that page was not opened and is not used, so a human should check current trail status before any visit. Record elevation_m is null; 6,585 ft is about 2,007 m by conversion, not added to the record. Record status and kind agree with the sources; no corrections proposed.
